boundary.evidence: Both title pages identify Schmidt's 1867 editio altera, indice glossarum ethnicarum aucta. Both independent physical copies contain the continuous printed sequence 257–258, 259–260, 261–262. The earlier Harvard source hesychiialexand00schmgoog omits the middle leaf after a repeated gathering. Column 259 begins αὐθέκαστος, immediately after αὐθέκαστα in 258; column 260 ends with the lemma αὐλώνων and its Euripides reference, without a printed definition in that main-text line. Column 261 starts αὐλωπίαι. Do not invent a definition or import the apparatus's alternative assignment of the preceding definitions.
